name: Gästehaus Marco
beschreibung:
Perched just above the village center of Soelden, Gaestehaus Marco delights guests with sweeping valley views and contemporary living comfort. Bright interiors ensure total relaxation.

The Giggijoch cable car station, alpine trails, and local ski buses are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Marco in Soelden provides modern apartments and guestrooms with panoramic views in Oetztal.
